name: GNU-Darwin Workstation
direction: Faithful reconstruction of selected original gray GNU-Darwin scientific workstation screenshot: flat gray controls, square bevels, slate titles, black workspace, right and bottom 64px square dock tiles.
source_concept: Original GNU-Darwin project today.png archived20021016083440; exact source and measured pixels in identity/source-samples.json. User selected this gray scientific workstation, superseding Aqua for this new separate preset.

typography.verification: fc-list confirms Liberation Sans/Mono. Screenshot does not establish original font names; neutral compact installed substitutes approximate bitmap-era metrics. Antialiasing may differ; no font installation.

geometry.panel_position: right and bottom; no top panel
geometry.panel_groups: right vertical launcher/task tiles; bottom square application/status tiles. No centered floating dock or top menu bar.
geometry.geometry_note: Screenshot1280x1024: rightmost64px column and bottom64px row. Preserve logical64px tile pitch with48px icon artwork, no scaling inflation. Cinnamon right panel may reserve a monitor-edge strip and intersect bottom panel; integration must explicitly assign the corner once.
geometry.composition: Black uncovered workspace. Rectangular gray applications use 1px light top/left and dark bottom/right bevels, compact menu rows and square controls. Inactive slate-gray titlebars; active near-black slate titlebars with white centered titles, minimize at left and close at right. A continuous sequence of64px square icon tiles hugs the right edge; individual running-app/status tiles occupy the bottom edge with empty black space between groups. No Aqua pinstripes, blue waves, traffic lights, glass or global top panel. The user-requested workspace picker alone uses an elongated rounded strip and circular numbered indicators; launcher, task and status tiles remain square.

workspace_selector.shape: elongated fully rounded strip with native numbered workspace circles
workspace_selector.indicator_height: native panel allocation; no horizontal height constraints
workspace_selector.scope: native workspace-switcher only; horizontal top/bottom in Jesta/Cryostat; both orientations in Workstation
workspace_selector.states: unchanged geometry and foreground/background pairs in all eight native state combinations
workspace_selector.preservation: numbers, names/tooltips, click/scroll/keyboard/accessibility behavior and global workspace count/names unchanged

materials.text_surfaces: Opaque flat neutral gray utility chrome and white document/editor content. White-on-black terminal. Prefer-light application chrome.
materials.shadow: No soft blur shadow; narrow dark outline or hard 1px offset only.
materials.texture: Flat gray with square raised bevels; title active subtle dark slate horizontal gradient from sampled #21232B to #0E0F13; inactive #9EA0AC. No brushed metal or pinstripes.
materials.motion: Use existing short Cinnamon transitions; no dock magnification or custom animation.
materials.wallpaper: Solid black #000000, matching visible uncovered screenshot pixels. No logo, wordmark, wave or invented scene.
materials.dock: 64px square tiles, medium slate-gray tile faces and hard light upper-left/dark lower-right bevel. Icon artwork max48px centered; no enclosing rounded dock body.

artwork.source: Original GNU-Darwin today.png source screenshot is research reference, not wallpaper. Solid black new wallpaper requires no copied artwork. Use installed application icons with resolved source path/license provenance; reuse exact original icons only if independently recovered with provenance. Licensed modern WindowMaker package assets recovered in proposals/gnu-darwin-archive/windowmaker-assets/extracted may supply defaultterm/GNUterm/pdf/wilber/staroffice2/write/GNUstepGlow/clip icons with package provenance. These are documented modern packaged substitutes, not claimed byte-identical screenshot artwork.
artwork.instruction: Do not crop icons out of the screenshot and call them original assets. No fabricated branding or replacement original Fastfetch art. Menu icon may use installed distributor icon with provenance; preserve exact menu label le cinabon. Keep new monochrome generic control glyphs authored locally; map screenshot dock application function to installed launcher without changing application content.

preserve: Exact current menu label le cinabon
Carbon Typewriter host selection during staging
All GNU-Darwin Aqua assets and all GNUOS NT assets unchanged
Shell and custom music commands, mixed MPV/Cava behavior
Original Fastfetch artwork, short/long modes, plain fastfetch stays short, Local IP86.75-309
Unrelated app preferences and document/media contents

semantic_rules.small_accent_text: Accent is text-safe on all light canvases; its role is subdued slate selection and focus, not a bright brand hue.
semantic_rules.primary_buttons: Normal gray surface with foreground label and square bevel; selected/pressed selection with white selection_foreground. No glossy cap.
semantic_rules.borders: control_border is essential edge; border decorative only. Bevel highlight #FFFFFF and lower edge #595959. Focus visible2px slate inset or dashed ring, not blue glow.
semantic_rules.secondary: Secondary/status text values pass4.5 on gray canvases; pair statuses with labels/icons.
semantic_rules.rainbow: Neutral ramp for technical diagrams only, no rainbow branding.
semantic_rules.ansi_black: Slot0 uses readable gray on black; ANSI slot8 brighter gray. Preserve white terminal text and black background matching source.
semantic_rules.states: Normal light-gray/black text; hover elevated/foreground; selected slate/white; focus2px slate; disabled #595959 without additional opacity; urgent error on elevated with icon. Active title white on sampled dark gradient; inactive title #101010 on#9EA0AC. Control minimize and close white glyphs on active title, dark glyphs on inactive title.
semantic_rules.light_preference: GTK prefer-dark false; color-scheme prefer-light. Terminal explicitly black independent of application preference.
semantic_rules.source_fidelity: Literal: sampled neutral gray, slate titles, white-on-black terminal, square bevels,64px right and bottom tiles, black uncovered desktop. Adaptations: Cinnamon menu/status affordances and launcher mapping, modern fonts/contrast, no cloned scientific documents, arbitrary app contents or obsolete executable code. Original screenshot cannot establish hidden wallpaper pixels or beta2.5 default.
semantic_rules.hue_census: A slate accent intentionally follows the selected historical screenshot; close blue/slate hue warnings are expected and accepted for source fidelity. Distinctness comes from grayscale bevels/right dock/black terminal, not invented hue.

panel_layout.comment: Source-led right dock and bottom app/status row. Three newly allocated applet instances (panel-launchers, calendar and the workstation monitor) need independent journaled allocation/restore. Keep exact le cinabon label on bottom horizontal menu.
panel_layout.restore: Journal all three new applet IDs and settings paths independently, allocate from current next-applet-id, restore removed multi-instance settings byte-exact before original panel arrays/applets, remove only newly allocated instance settings after original layout restored, preserve monotonic next-applet-id, and restore exact menu through menu receipt. Rehearse two-panel right/bottom corner ownership before any host activation.
panel_layout.launcher_policy: Coordinator resolves installed application desktop IDs and explicit launcherList before build, preserving stable screenshot functional sequence where installed: terminal, browser, office, editor, scientific graphics, image editor, PDF, file manager. No guessed missing desktop IDs; record mapping/provenance.
panel_layout.corner_policy: Bottom panel owns lower-right corner; right dock rail ends above bottom64px row. Bottom center stays empty black.
panel_layout.task_policy: Stock grouped-window-list tiles represent running windows, not solely minimized windows or free-positioned WindowMaker miniwindows.

resource_monitor.placement: panel2:right:0; before unchanged relative status/clock order

appearance.bezel: Existing surface #B3B2B0; square white upper-left and control_border #595959 lower-right bevel; radius0
appearance.font: Liberation Mono, labels9px bold and values10px regular; no fractional scaling required
appearance.layout: Each64px tile: 4px bezel; label y6..17; value y19..31; graph y35..57, width54px. No labels over graphs. Tooltip expands full metric/interface/unit details.
appearance.graph_style: 54 one-pixel columns, one new sample per second, no glow/smoothing; dark unused graph pixels. Colour is supplemented by CPU/MEM/RX/TX labels and numeric values.

sampling.method: Single shared GLib timeout; read /proc/stat, /proc/meminfo and /proc/net/dev through in-process file APIs; no subprocess polling, shell loops, external services or network requests. Remove timer on applet removal.
sampling.cpu: Aggregate CPU utilization from successive total/idle+iowait counter deltas; exclude guest fields already included in user/nice. Show rounded0..100%. First sample or nonpositive total delta => -- and graph gap; never fabricated zero.
sampling.memory: (MemTotal-MemAvailable)/MemTotal, clamp0..100; rounded percent. Missing MemAvailable => -- rather than counting cache as used or inventing a fallback. Tooltip shows used/total bytes and definition.
sampling.network: Select one active default-route interface from /proc/net/route (lowest metric; stable name tie-break), excluding loopback. If no IPv4 route, support IPv6 default route via /proc/net/ipv6_route. Do not sum virtual/physical interfaces and double-count traffic. RX/TX from that interface counters divided by actual monotonic elapsed time; interface name in tooltip.
sampling.rate_format: ASCII compact bytes/second: 0B/s,999B/s,1.0K/s,999K/s,1.0M/s,999M/s,1.0G/s; K/M/G binary1024 units, tooltip spells KiB/s etc. Maximum6 visible characters for typical rates; at >=1000GiB/s use >999G with exact tooltip.
sampling.graphs: CPU/MEM fixed0..100% scale. RX/TX share a rolling54-sample ceiling, minimum1KiB/s, labelled scale in tooltip; auto scale is visual only, numeric rate always actual. Reset history when interface changes.
sampling.errors: Missing/read-error/no usable interface => -- with tooltip reason and empty graph, no repeated alerts. Counter decrease/interface change => baseline/reset gap, never negative or huge spike. Actual valid zero => 0% or0B/s. On long interval >5s discard CPU/network delta and rebaseline; retain memory snapshot.
sampling.warnings: CPU or memory >=90% uses warning ink plus ! in label (CPU!/MEM!), no flashing; CPU! reads current high usage rather than a fault. Network has no arbitrary danger threshold. Missing/reset state uses --, not error colour alone.

resource_monitor.provenance: WMMon/WMNet-style descriptive period adaptation requested by user; not a claim of exact screenshot app identity, asset bytes or original widget code. All monitor graph/control drawing newly authored with existing palette/ANSI colours.
resource_monitor.verification_api: Expose read-only getMetricsSnapshot() returning sequence, monotonic timestamp, cpuPercent, memoryPercent, rxBytesPerSec, txBytesPerSec, interfaceName, disposed and sourceId; unavailable numbers null. Snapshot must be copied data, no side effects. Private harness checks two advancing real samples, then retains applet reference across removal and verifies disposed=true/sourceId=0/no further sequence advance.
